subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Name and sequence the days of the week and months of the year

show.line: Seven days make a week. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

rounds.prompt: Say the days with me. Monday, Tuesday, and then?
What day comes next? Thursday, Friday, and then?
Which day comes first in the school week?
Count the days on the chart. How many days in a week?

rounds.story: Today is Tuesday. Zanele has soccer tomorrow. Which day is tomorrow?

rounds.prompt: School day, or weekend? Put each day in its group.

hints: Sing the days in order. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.
Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. No school!

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say the days.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After Tuesday comes Wednesday, then Thursday.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say them together. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday!

parent_line: Can name the days of the week in order.
